# @demlik/tea for coding agents

Version: 0.30.0
Use the docs and types shipped in this package: `node_modules/@demlik/tea/docs/` and `node_modules/@demlik/tea/dist/**/*.d.ts`.
The API changed between versions. Prefer these files over memory, external documentation and other copies of tea.
IMPORTANT: Prefer retrieval-led reasoning over pre-training-led reasoning. Read the relevant page before writing code.

## Before you hand-write it

| When | Use | From | Page |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Replies arrive out of order and an older answer overwrites newer state; ignore late answers | `defineMachine`, `Identity`. Replaces a request id kept in State and compared in every update cell; give defineMachine an identity: { ofState, ofMsg } | `@demlik/tea` | [Read](docs/how-to/ignore-a-late-answer.md) |
| You step the machine yourself and must ignore late answers | `matchesIdentity`, `applyCell`. Replaces a custom filter; call matchesIdentity before applyCell | `@demlik/tea` | [Read](docs/how-to/ignore-a-late-answer.md#3-step-the-machine-in-your-own-host) |
| Save to your own database or ledger that can append atomically and read in order | `Journal`, `eventSourcedStore`. Replaces a Store that keeps only the latest State and no log; eventSourcedStore retains owed work (one writer per stream) | `@demlik/tea/persistence` | [Read](docs/how-to/make-durable.md) |
| Save the latest State in one SQL row with compare-and-set | `rowStore`. Replaces hand-written revision fencing; use a RowPort and { fenced: true } | `@demlik/tea/persistence` | [Read](docs/reference/persistence.md#rowStore) |
| Two processes may write the same machine's log | `FencedJournal`, `eventSourcedStore`. Replaces unchecked appends; supply a FencedJournal and { fenced: true } | `@demlik/tea/persistence` | [Read](docs/reference/persistence.md#eventSourcedStore) |
| Check whether your storage driver preserves order and atomic batches | `journalConformance`. Replaces a home-grown driver test suite; inspect failed and skipped cases | `@demlik/tea/pbt` | [Read](docs/reference/persistence.md#check-a-host-written-journal) |
| Work takes longer than one call or the platform's request limit | `owed`. Replaces awaiting the whole job; durably hand off, return owed(), then dispatch(msg, { answerTo }) on a later call (logged store required) | `@demlik/tea` | [Read](docs/how-to/make-durable.md#6-hand-long-work-to-an-external-owner) |
| List what is still waiting for an answer | `logLedger`. Replaces a second pending-work list; read logLedger(await store.readLog()).surviving() | `@demlik/tea` | [Read](docs/how-to/make-durable.md#6-hand-long-work-to-an-external-owner) |
| The host must wake the machine at its next deadline after the call ends | `deadlinesSub`, `deadlineExceeded`. Replaces an in-process timer after stop; share the State deadline selector and set the platform alarm in the host | `@demlik/tea/resilience` | [Read](docs/how-to/make-durable.md#5-end-each-call-and-return-the-next-alarm) |
| An effect needs typed success and error results | `Cmd.define`. Replaces hand-written outcome Msgs; declare input and ok schemas and err tags | `@demlik/tea` | [Read](docs/how-to/run-on-the-promise-engine.md) |
| The saved State shape changed and old saves must still load | `schemaMigrate`. Replaces repeated boundary parsing; give Store.migrate a schemaMigrate(schema, upcast) | `@demlik/tea` | [Read](docs/reference/tea.md#schemaMigrate) |
| The same request or job can arrive twice (a retry, a redelivery after a crash); do its work once per id | `createIntake`, `seen`, `remember`. Replaces a hand-kept Set of processed ids in State; keep an IdempotencyStore in the Model and check seen before the work | `@demlik/tea/idempotency` | [Read](docs/reference/idempotency.md) |
